text: Entry Requirements Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy; Applicants shall hold a high school diploma before September 1, 2026; Applicants should not be older than 25; Applicants’ academic grade in the previous stage should not be less than 75%; Applicants shall complete the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) prior to the application deadline. Relevant test subjects, download here . Applicants for Chinese-taught Programs should have the Chinese proficiency of HSK 4 or above. Applicants who previously held Chinese citizenship shall have obtained foreign nationality and renounced their Chinese nationality before April 30, 2022. Additionally, they shall have resided abroad for more than 2 years between April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Record of actual foreign residency for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, referring to the entry and exit date signatures).
